abstract: The sonographic appearance of 6 solid benign cystic teratomas (in 5 patients) was reviewed. Three of these tumors were difficult to identify due to the presence of acoustical shadowing obscuring the posterior portions of the tumors. This appearance was mistaken ultrasonically for bowel gas. The tumors were diagnosed by abdominal radiographs showing calcifications, teeth and/or radiolucency due to fat. With the presence of a clinically palpable pelvic mass in a young woman, and an apparently normal sonogram, an abdominal radiograph should be considered to look for evidence of a benign cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 6例の充実性に見える良性嚢胞性奇形腫（5患者）の超音波所見を検討した。このうち3例は後方の音響陰影により腫瘍の後部が不明瞭となり、腸管ガスと誤認された。腫瘍は、石灰化、歯、脂肪による透亮像を示す腹部X線写真によって診断された。若い女性で骨盤内に触知可能な腫瘤があり、超音波検査が正常な場合は、良性嚢胞性奇形腫の有無を確認するため腹部X線撮影を検討すべきである。
